GradMax: Growing Neural Networks using Gradient Information
Evci et al. | ICLR 2022
This fixture summarizes a real paper about adding neurons during training.
GradMax grows a network without disturbing learned behavior and initializes
new weights to maximize useful gradients through an SVD-based procedure.
The paper reports improved training dynamics across several vision settings.

Them Optimally
